snap_down_object: snap a rigid object onto the nearest support surface in the gravity direction
get_obj_from_id: get a ManagedRigidObject or ManagedArticulatedObject from its integer object id
ontop_objects: get all object ids resting on top of a given object using collision contact points
open_link: set an articulated object link to its fully open state at maximum joint limit
match_point_to_receptacle: match a 3D point to the nearest candidate receptacle and return confidence score
